English translation from the Modern Amharic of the EOTC Bible (nehemiah-osc.org) by Claude (Anthropic) with collaborator, May 2026. Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication (archive.org/details/three-books-of-meqabyan-cc0-translation). Apparatus integrates Josef Horovitz, 'Das äthiopische Maccabäerbuch,' Zeitschrift für Assyriologie XIX (1905), pp. 194-233 — PD primary scholarly study. 64-citation third-pass audit verdict matrix; 57 verified, 4 errors corrected, 3 interpretive readings flagged, 7 newly discovered parallels added. Dating widened to Aksumite-to-Solomonic Ethiopian Christian range (4th-14th c. CE); precise composition date undetermined in current scholarship per Horovitz 1905 non-commitment. Three books: 1 Mq 36 chapters (Maqabis-of-Benjamin martyrology vs Ṣiruṣaydan); 2 Mq 21 chapters (Maqabis-of-Moab conversion + sons' martyrdom + Ṣiruṣaydan's death); 3 Mq 10 chapters (homiletic + angelological dialogue + Satan-refused-Adam tradition + resurrection-doctrine).

OPENS Ch 3 — HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR (per source-fidelity note: this entry frames the chapter's likely theological-content based on homiletic-anthology genre-expectation + the Ch 2-→-4 doctrinal trajectory). Ch 3 likely develops the divine-mercy-as-overcoming-Devil's-deception theme inaugurated at Ch 2:5+. The probable homiletic-development continues the THEODICY-VIA-JOB-PARADIGM framework — extending Job's-vindication to general-human-vindication. Patristic-genre parallels for this structural position: CHRYSOSTOM Homilies on Genesis 19 (theodicy-after-Fall); GREGORY OF NYSSA Cat Or 8 (the lost-image and divine-condescension); AMBROSE De Cain et Abel 1.10 (the early-Fall theodicy). Tewahedo homiletic tradition preserves the post-judgment-mercy structural-position as the soteriological pivot. The chapter likely establishes the THEODICY-PIVOT from cosmic-rebellion (Ch 1) → divine-judgment (Ch 2) → promised-restoration (Ch 3) → theological-systematics (Ch 4).

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of divine-permission-of-suffering theme. The chapter's likely-mid-section continues the theodicy-architecture: divine-permission of Satan-deception is framed as preparatory-for-divine-victory rather than as concession-to-Devil. The permission-as-preparation theme parallels: ROMANS 8:18-30 (the present sufferings and the glory which shall be revealed); 2 CORINTHIANS 4:17 (the light affliction working a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory); 1 PETER 1:6-7 (the trial-of-faith as more-precious-than-gold); JOB 23:10 ('when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold'); WISDOM OF SOLOMON 3:1-9 (the souls of the righteous in the hand of God + trial-as-purification). The Tewahedo Sǝnkǝsar (Synaxarium) preserves the trial-as-preparation theme in saints'-lives commemorations; the patristic-monastic tradition systematizes it as the via-purgativa.
